reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Other Changes: There are many other PRs which were merged in this release cycle and we'd encourage you to read the release notes below", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: log output format has changed; environments that parse or filter cert-manager logs using text-based tools may need to update their log filtering logic.

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 adds more structured logging information to certain log lines, changing their format; text-based log filtering tools may be affected.
